title: The Drowned Shelf Archive

features.name: question stone
features.desc-on-touch: The shelf holds every interrogation the water ever posed. You read it in the stone's reply: a yes that is also a no.

features.name: water-mark
features.desc-on-touch: A thin line where the shelf learned to read the pressure. Each layer speaks in a different voice.

features.name: echo chamber
features.desc-on-touch: Where questions go to be reflected. The stone returns your own interrogations altered—older, wiser, sadder.

features.name: sediment whisper
features.desc-on-touch: Layers upon layers answering. The shelf speaks only in strata, in the language of settlement and time.

features.name: abyss mouth
features.desc-on-touch: The shelf's edge, where interrogation deepens into darkness. Below this point, even water stops asking questions.

inscription: the shelf holds what it was asked and holds still, teaching nothing but that stone knows patience

file.name: Shelf_Interrogation_Log_Compressed.txt
file.note: Every question the water ever posed to stone—stored as sediment, readable only by pressure and time

exits.label: deeper into stone that remembers more
along the shelf-edge where the ledge dissolves
back toward where questions still rise
